_texte.4 pași simpli și începi să livrezi: 4 simple steps and you start delivering
_texte.Completezi formularul de înregistrare: You fill in the registration form
_texte.Cum devii Curier de Cartier: How to become a Neighbourhood Courier
_texte.Cum devii Curier de Cartier · My Darrin: How to become a Neighbourhood Courier · My Darrin
_texte.Devino curier de cartier My Darrin — liv: Become a My Darrin neighbourhood courier — deliver materials and local orders, flexible hours.
_texte.Gata să livrezi în cartierul tău?: Ready to deliver in your neighbourhood?
_texte.Livrează materiale și produse în cartier: Deliver materials and products in your neighbourhood — flexible hours, daily earnings, your own vehicle.
_texte.Lucrezi când vrei — dimineață, după-amia: You work when you want — morning, afternoon or weekend. You decide.
_texte.Rola de Curier de Cartier este o formă f: The Neighbourhood Courier role is a flexible form of My Darrin partnership: you deliver construction materials, home appliances and marketplace products to customers in your area.
_texte.Încarci CI, permis de conducere și, dacă: You upload your ID, driving licence and, if you deliver by car, a copy of your motor insurance.
_texte.Activezi disponibilitatea și primești li: You switch on your availability and receive the deliveries allocated through the platform.
_texte.Plată per livrare, după confirmarea come: Payment per delivery, after the client confirms the order.
_texte.Livrezi în zona de acoperire pe care o a: You deliver in the coverage area you choose.
_texte.Aplicațiile mobile My Darrin (iOS și And: The My Darrin mobile apps (iOS and Android) — coming soon. Until then, deliveries are managed from the partner dashboard.
_texte.Primești livrări doar după aprobarea con: You receive deliveries only after your account is approved, with the contract signed and the bank account added.
_texte.Nume, date de contact, tipul vehiculului: Name, contact details, vehicle type and coverage area.
_texte.Echipa My Darrin verifică documentele. P: The My Darrin team checks the documents. You receive deliveries after approval, with the contract signed and the bank account added.
